name: Lariss Pavilion
summary: At Lariss Pavilion, dryads attack those who draw near. The ancient retreat north of Camp Mojache now shelters an exiled Highborne mage.

sections.title: A Ruin of the Highborne
sections.body: You stand on the bluffs north of Camp Mojache, where graceful stonework and towering arches overlook Feralas's dense canopy. The kaldorei empire built Lariss Pavilion to serve Eldre'Thalas, the great city now called Dire Maul. Yet the glades around it offer no safe refuge. Dryads once wandered here gently, but madness and corruption have taken hold. Now they attack anyone who draws near.

sections.title: Azj'Tordin and the Hidden Passage
sections.body: Azj'Tordin, an elusive elf, has made his home at Lariss Pavilion. He broke from Prince Tortheldrin's decadent rule in Dire Maul and escaped through a secret passage linking the pavilion to the ancient city's underbelly. But his quiet exile was disturbed by Pusillin, an erratic imp who stole his treasured book of incantations. Now the Highborne seeks outside aid to recover it.

aliases: how to get to lariss pavilion
faq.answer: Lariss Pavilion rises above the forest in eastern Feralas, just north of Camp Mojache, the Horde outpost.

aliases: who is the elf at lariss pavilion
faq.answer: Azj'Tordin is an ancient Highborne sorcerer who fled Prince Tortheldrin's tyrannical rule in Dire Maul. He now camps at the pavilion and seeks help reclaiming his stolen book of incantations from an imp.

faq.q: Why are the dryads around the pavilion hostile?
faq.answer: Corruption spreading through Feralas has overcome the dryads near the pavilion. These normally reclusive guardians of nature have become vicious attackers.

faq.q: How does the pavilion connect to Dire Maul?
faq.answer: A concealed passage at the base of Lariss Pavilion leads into Dire Maul. Azj'Tordin used it to escape his brethren.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see in Azj'Tordin, the solitary Highborne, a living relic of Eldre'Thalas's ancient, unchecked spellcraft.
As a night elf, Lariss Pavilion may be a bitter sight. Highborne hubris shadows its beauty, and corruption afflicts the dryads who are your kin.
